# `streaming_completion_requires_90_percent`

> A play only counts as complete (royalties, recommendations) after 90% of the content.

| | |
|---|---|
| Domain | [streaming](README.md) |
| Layer | **silver** — evaluated by the `silver` gate |
| Model | `slv_streaming__playback_events` (`streaming_silver.slv_streaming__playback_events`) |
| Check | `expression_is_true` |
| Severity | `error` — a violation **stops the pipeline** |
| Defined in | [dbt/models/streaming/silver/_silver.yml](../../../dbt/models/streaming/silver/_silver.yml) |

## What it checks

Every row satisfies `event_type <> 'complete' or position_seconds >= 0.9 * content_duration_seconds`.

## When it fails

The `silver` task of `medallion_streaming` fails, gold and `publish_gold` don't run, and the batch is never added to `streaming_gold`: consumers keep the batches published before. `quality_report` marks the run as blocked and sends the alert, if one is configured.

The rows that broke the rule in its latest evaluation are kept in `dq_audit.streaming_completion_requires_90_percent`.

## Tested by

Scenario **`premature_completion`**: 'complete' event before 90% of the content was played.

```bash
make generate DOMAIN=streaming SCENARIO=premature_completion BATCH=2026-10-20_premature_completion
make pipeline DOMAIN=streaming BATCH=2026-10-20_premature_completion
```

```sql

-- history of the rule

from dq_audit.rule_results
where rule = 'streaming_completion_requires_90_percent'

```
